text_block_list.text:
Starting today, our Twinkle Series challenge
with Grass Wonder is officially
underway in earnest!

Wanting to discuss future plans right away,
I visited Grass Wonder's classroom a little before
training began, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Spe-chan.
That kanji practice has a little mistake in it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Wh-Where, where!? Which one, which one!?
(Special Week—an Umamusume from Hokkaido who belongs to the same generation as Grass Wonder.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"There, there, calm down now.
It's the problem right under your hand~."
(Seiun Sky—an Umamusume who made her debut around the same time, known for her rather subtle, enigmatic way of speaking.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The 'ka' in 'person caught in the vortex' is written with the kanji for 'whirlpool'.
Spe-chan, you wrote the one for 'calamity'.
Let's fix the radical, okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, um, um... Like this!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, your handwriting is way too messy, desu!
It looks like a drawing of some kind of bug!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How terrible!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see. If even El is commenting on the quality of your handwriting, it really must be something~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's awful!?!?
(El Condor Pasa—a lively Umamusume who shares a dorm room with Grass Wonder and debuted in the same class.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Spe-chan, there's still plenty of time.
Calm down and write it again~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hai-ee...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
You were here?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Grass-chan's Trainer,
are you starting training already!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...!
It's all my faultttt...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, actually... my score on the recent quiz was
so bad that I have to take supplementary lessons...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was told I'm not allowed to go to training
until I finish all these worksheets~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, this is an important period leading up to your Make Debut.
We cannot afford a lack of training, so—
choice_data_list: Is everyone pitching in to help?
Everyone's pitching in to help, huh.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! So Spe-chan,
there's no time to be crying!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Guts! Grit! And EFFOOOORT!!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Though you really should've put in the effort before the test~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's exactly riiiight~~!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... So that's how it is, Trainer-san.
Could you please wait for just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Shall we continue, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"‘Haste makes waste’—at times like this,
let us stay calm and cherish this opportunity to learn."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The "kachu" (maelstrom) we just talked about uses the "uzu" (whirlpool) character... That means it's related to water, so we use the "water radical"~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I see...! I'll make sure to relearn it properly!
Grass Wonder calmly continued giving brief yet thorough explanations afterward, helping Special Week with her remedial study.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for earlier,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Everyone really gets along well, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. They're all so unique and fun,
and such precious friends of mine~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course, not only that—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Since they debuted in the same year, they will often compete in the same races and push each other as rivals.
Without ever breaking her calm and gentle tone.

Still, the air surrounding Grass Wonder
grows faintly tense...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
—You wanted to talk about our future plans, yes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's a lot we need to discuss, like the training menu and race rotations, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: First of all, there is something I would like to give you.

With those words, Grass Wonder
held out a sheet of calligraphy paper.

Unfolding it, written there in dignified handwriting
that radiated an unyielding will――

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: “No Retreat”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will not retreat, nor will I yield. I shall continue forward.
Until I reach the pinnacle of the path I have chosen to walk.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This is—my written oath.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Could you hold on to this for me?

"It weighs no more than a single sheet of calligraphy paper. Even so,
packed with a determination that felt heavy in my hands,
I tucked it away with great care."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be in your care,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's take our first steps toward the top.

First is the Make a Debut...
The challenge with Grass Wonder had begun!
